title: 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair performed front-end collision repair on a 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI damaged in a hit-and-run incident.
story: This 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair following a hit-and-run incident. The impact concentrated on the front passenger side, causing panel misalignments around the hood, fender, headlight, and front bumper cover.

Our technicians thoroughly evaluated the vehicle and marked affected components for repair or replacement. The work required realigning body lines, replacing the damaged front fender, and removing and re-installing the headlight and front bumper assembly for proper fitment.

After fitting the new components and prepping the surface, the repaired sections were refinished in Metallic Dark Gray to match the original factory color. Final assembly and gap checks ensured the front end was fully restored.
